description: This file defines the ReconnectActor class, an Akka actor responsible for managing reconnection logic for connections in the Eclipse Ditto connectivity messaging service. It handles scheduling reconnection attempts, processing responses, and coordinating reconnect procedures based on persisted connection IDs.

classes.name: ReconnectActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that manages automatic reconnection attempts for a set of connections, scheduling retries, handling incoming responses and exceptions, and coordinating reconnection logic based on persisted connection IDs.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props configuration for the actor with a MongoReadJournal for reading persisted IDs.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props configuration for the actor with a supplier of persistence ID sources.

methods.name: preStart
methods.description: Initializes scheduling of periodic reconnection checks when the actor starts.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Cancels scheduled reconnect tasks when the actor stops.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling behavior of the actor, including responses to reconnection commands and status responses.

methods.name: handleStartReconnect
methods.description: Handles the initiation of a reconnection cycle, throttling the process and managing ongoing attempts.

methods.name: handleEndReconnect
methods.description: Handles the completion of a reconnection cycle, resetting internal state.

methods.name: reconnect
methods.description: Initiates a reconnection request for a specific persisted connection ID.

methods.name: toCorrelationId
methods.description: Converts a ConnectionId object into a correlation ID string used in messaging.

methods.name: toConnectionId
methods.description: Parses a correlation ID string to extract the associated ConnectionId, if valid.

methods.name: getReconnectConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the reconnect configuration from the actor's system context.
